title: G7 to release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel after Trump export ban threat

beats.caption: G7 releases up to *100 million barrels* of oil and diesel
beats.narration: The G7 is releasing up to 100 million barrels of emergency oil and diesel.

beats.caption: Fuel prices *surged* as the Iran war hit Gulf supplies
beats.narration: Fuel prices surged after the war on Iran disrupted Gulf oil supplies.
beats.fact: UK diesel hits a record £2 a litre

beats.caption: UK diesel: a record *£2 a litre*
beats.narration: In Britain, diesel just hit a record two pounds a litre.

beats.caption: Trump threatened to *ban US diesel exports*
beats.narration: Then Trump threatened to ban US diesel exports, to cut prices before November's elections.

beats.caption: Pressure, crisis talks, then a *coordinated release*
beats.narration: After crisis talks, G7 leaders agreed a coordinated release over four months.

caption:
The G7 is releasing up to 100 million barrels of emergency oil and diesel.

Diesel hit a record £2 a litre in the UK after the Iran war disrupted Gulf supplies, and President Trump threatened to ban US diesel exports. G7 leaders agreed a coordinated release over the next four months, and oil prices fell as much as 5% on the news.
